mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the two main routes was most worthwhile: the arrows showed a full lap passing through the heart twice.

leastWorthwhile.text: Building the two separate routes felt a little repetitive, though the labels made their purposes clear.

surprise.text: I hadn't thought about the heart muscle needing its own blood vessels, separate from the blood in its chambers.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; the labeled openings explained the connections, even when only one combination was offered.

continue.text: Yes. I'd be curious to see how the lungs add oxygen to the blood, since this chapter showed the route but not the air sacs.
